column1: # ccd/contexts.tsv: every function ccd/ccd defines, mapped to ONE context of the 08-10 architecture spec
# (C1 Fleet Registry & Accounts, C2 Fleet Mutation, C3 Session Conversation, C4 Workspace Lifecycle, C5 Coordination,
# C6 Attention & Notification, C7 Update control plane, C8 Auth & box token, C9 Docs; K = kernels and platform, no
# aggregate). D-6054 (ARCH-34, #536). Data only: no installer reads it, and ccd/ccd never sources it.
# server/test/ccd-contexts.test.ts holds it: every definition has exactly one row, every row names a definition,
# and the cross-context reference count may only shrink. A NEW FUNCTION NEEDS A ROW in the same change.
# Rows are in definition order: <function name><TAB><context>.
